tagline.en: An open take on Dreamer 4 — a diffusion world model you steer through Minecraft actions.
tagline.zh: Dreamer 4 的开放实现——一个用 Minecraft 动作操控的扩散世界模型。

en: Open Dreamer is an open reimplementation in the Dreamer 4 lineage — a diffusion-based, interactive world model. It simulates a Minecraft-style environment that you drive with actions, predicting how the world evolves in response to what you do.

You provide a short context clip and a stream of interactions; WorldFoundry renders those interactions into the Minecraft/VPT action space and the model rolls out the resulting video. Context clips are expected as RGB frames at the model's trained resolution, and the rollout runs in the project's own JAX/CUDA environment.

Note that the upstream source is not bundled — it carries an all-rights-reserved notice and publishes no downloadable weights. To run Open Dreamer you point WorldFoundry at your own checkout and a checkpoint you have trained or supplied yourself.
zh: Open Dreamer 是 Dreamer 4 谱系下的一个开放实现——一个基于扩散的交互式世界模型。它模拟一个 Minecraft 风格的环境，你用动作来驱动，模型会预测世界如何随你的操作演化。
你提供一小段上下文片段和一串交互动作；WorldFoundry 会把这些交互渲染进 Minecraft/VPT 动作空间，模型据此推演出视频。上下文片段需是模型训练分辨率下的 RGB 帧，推演在项目自带的 JAX/CUDA 环境中运行。
需要注意的是，上游源码并不随附——它附带保留所有权利的声明，也未发布可下载的权重。要运行 Open Dreamer，你需要让 WorldFoundry 指向你自己的检出目录和一个由你自己训练或提供的 checkpoint。

whenToUse.en: Use Open Dreamer when you want an interactive, diffusion-based Minecraft world model in the Dreamer 4 style and you can bring your own trained checkpoint and environment.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个 Dreamer 4 风格、基于扩散的交互式 Minecraft 世界模型，并且能自备训练好的 checkpoint 与运行环境时，可以使用 Open Dreamer。

notFor.en: There are no downloadable weights and the source is not open for redistribution — you must train or supply your own checkpoint, and set up its JAX/CUDA environment. Not a plug-and-play, ready-weights option.
notFor.zh: 它没有可下载的权重，源码也不开放再分发——你必须自行训练或提供 checkpoint，并搭建其 JAX/CUDA 环境。它不是开箱即用、权重现成的选项。

en: Diffusion-based interactive world model in the Dreamer 4 lineage
Driven by Minecraft/VPT actions through WorldFoundry interactions
Runs against your own checkout in a JAX/CUDA environment
Bring-your-own checkpoint — no downloadable weights upstream
zh: Dreamer 4 谱系下、基于扩散的交互式世界模型
通过 WorldFoundry 交互驱动 Minecraft/VPT 动作
在 JAX/CUDA 环境中基于你自己的检出运行
需自备 checkpoint——上游无可下载权重
